viltrumitecore.city.help.title: Living city commands:
viltrumitecore.city.help.disable: - turn the city off and remove all citizens
viltrumitecore.city.help.populate: <count> - add citizens around you right now
viltrumitecore.city.help.clear: - remove all citizens (the city stays on)
viltrumitecore.city.help.status: - city, citizens, districts and restore state
viltrumitecore.city.help.reset: - restore every destroyed block of the map
viltrumitecore.city.error.no_city: This world has no prepared living city (install the prepared Atheria world).
viltrumitecore.city.error.disabled: The city is off. Run /city enable first.
viltrumitecore.city.error.restoring: The map is being restored right now. Wait for /city reset to finish.
viltrumitecore.city.status.title: City %s (map %s)
viltrumitecore.city.status.districts_non: Active districts: none (%s districts in total)
viltrumitecore.city.status.crowd: 人群：平静 %s，警觉 %s，逃跑 %s，躲藏 %s（移动威胁：%s）
viltrumitecore.city.status.restore_dirty: Map: %s changed blocks in %s chunks (/city reset restores them)
viltrumitecore.city.enabled: Living city %s is on: citizens walk the streets around players.
viltrumitecore.city.disabled: Living city is off, %s citizens removed.
viltrumitecore.city.density.set: Density %s: about %s citizens around each player.
viltrumitecore.city.density.hint: The city is off: the density applies after /city enable.
viltrumitecore.city.cleared.hint: The city is still on: the streets fill up again. Use /city disable to stop it.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.nothing: Nothing to restore: the map is in its original state.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.warn: Warning: %s changed blocks in %s chunks go back to the original map. Everything built or broken there is undone, citizens are removed.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.warn2: Type /city reset confirm within %s seconds to start. Player inventories are not touched.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.no_pending: No reset to confirm. Run /city reset first.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.started: Map restore started: %s blocks in %s chunks.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.request_cancel: Reset request cancelled, the map stays as it is.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.cancelled: Map restore stopped, %s blocks are still changed (/city reset continues).
viltrumitecore.city.reset.resumed: Resuming the interrupted map restore: %s blocks left.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.done: Map restored: %s blocks in %s chunks, %s passes, %s s.
viltrumitecore.city.reset.leftover: %s blocks could not be restored; run /city reset again.
